verdict.rationale: The evidence pack does not document versioning, review/diff, or rollback for monday.com automations. The nearest material is an adjacent developer feature: promoting app versions through the developer MCP. That covers app deployment, not automation version history or rollback, so it earns no credit here. Agent action auditing is also a different capability from reviewing or reverting automation changes.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can version, review, and roll back my automations

citations.quote: Scaffold, set env vars, and promote versions from chat.
